senses.gloss:
लग् लग् (this rt. is most extensively
and variously applied in spoken languages
allied to Sanskrit), cl. 1. P. लगति, ललाग, अलगीत्,
&c., to adhere, stick; to attach or fasten one's self
to, cling to, clasp; to touch, join, become united;
to meet, come in contact, intersect, cut (as lines); to
approach near, follow closely (on any event), ensue
or happen immediately; cl. 10. P. लागयति, &c.,
to taste; to obtain, (in these senses = rts. लक्, रक्):
Caus. लगयति, &c., to cause to adhere, &c.; [cf.
perhaps Gr. λήγω and, according to some, possibly
Lat. ligare.]

लगनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attached, to be
clung to.

लगित, अस्, आ, अम्, attached to, adhered, con-
nected with; obtained, got; entered.

लगित्वा, ind. having adhered, having clasped, hav-
ing closely approached so as to touch or join, (तस्य
पादयोर् लगित्वा, having clung to his feet.)

1. लग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see p. 860, col. 2),
attached, adhered, stuck, held fast; attached to, joined
to, connected with; coming in contact, meeting,
intersecting, cutting (said of lines); adhering or
clinging to, sticking to or upon, remaining on, im-
pressed upon, fastened in, sticking in; fastened on,
directed towards; followed or following closely, im-
mediately ensuing; intent on, closely occupied about;
auspicious; (अस्), m. a bard or minstrel (who awakes
the king in the morning); a furious elephant or one
in rut; (अम्), n. the point of contact or intersection
(of two lines), the point where the horizon and the
ecliptic or path of the planets meet; the point or arc
of the equator which corresponds to a given point
or arc of the ecliptic; the division of the equator
which rises in succession with each sign in an oblique
sphere; the point of the ecliptic which at a given
time is upon the meridian or at the horizon, (क्षि-
तिजे लग्नम्, horizon Lagna; मध्य-लग्न, me-
ridian Lagna); the moment of the sun's entrance into
a zodiacal sign; the rising of the sun or of the
planets; (in astrology) a scheme or figure of the
twelve houses or zodiacal signs (used as a horoscope);
the whole of the first astrological house; an auspicious
moment, a particular time fixed upon as lucky for
the performance of anything, (rarely अस्, m.); the
decisive moment, time for action, decisive measure,
(also अस्, m.)
—लग्न-काल, अस्, m. the moment or
time pointed out by astrologers as favourable for any
undertaking, an auspicious moment or time.
—लग्-
न-ग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, insisting firmly on anything,
persisting steadfastly in, important, obtrusive.
—लग्-
न-चन्द्रिका, f., N. of an astronomical work.
—लग्न-दिन, अम्, n. or लग्न-दिवस, अस्, m.
an auspicious day, a day fixed upon or chosen as
favourable for any undertaking.
—लग्न-देवी, f.,
N. of a fabulous cow of stone.
—लग्न-नक्षत्र,
अम्, n. any auspicious constellation of the moon's
path.
—लग्न-पत्त्रिका, f. a paper on which the
auspicious moment for a marriage &c. is noted down.
—लग्न-भुज, अस्, m. (in astronomy) ascensional
difference.
—लग्न-मण्डल, अम्, n. the circle of
signs, the zodiac.
—लग्न-मास, अस्, m. an auspi-
cious month.
—लग्न-मुहूर्त, अम्, n. the auspi-
cious moment or period for a marriage, &c.
—लग्-
न-वेला, f. or लग्न-समय, अस्, m. = लग्न-काल.
—लग्न-शुद्धि, इस्, f. auspiciousness of the signs
&c. for the commencement of any contemplated
work.
—लग्नासु (˚न-असु), अवस्, m. pl. (in astro-
[]
nomy) ascensional equivalents in respirations.
—लग्-
नाह (˚न-अह), अस्, m. = लग्न-दिन.

2. लग्न, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see p. 858, col. 3),
ashamed; (this part. is also referrible to rt. 1. लज्.)

लग्नक, अस्, m. a (fixed) surety or security, one
who is responsible; a bondsman, bail.
लग्निका, f. incorrect for नग्निका, q. v.
लगालिका, f. a kind of metre, four times ˘¯˘¯.

लगड लगड, अस्, आ, अम्, beautiful, hand-
some; [cf. लडह.]

लगत लगत or लगध, अस्, m., N. of the
author of a work on astronomy.

लगुड लगुड, अस्, m. (perhaps connected
with rt. लग्), a stick, staff; a club, iron club.
—ल-
गुड-हस्त, अस्, m. ‘staff-in-hand,’ a man armed
with a stick or mace, a staff-bearer.

लागुडिक लागुडिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. लगुड),
armed with a club; (अस्), m. a sentinel.
